categories.main_business_segments: SUNeVision operates primarily in two segments: data centre and IT facilities, which includes colocation services, interconnection services, and managed services; and ELV and IT systems, which involves installation and maintenance of extra low voltage and IT systems. The data centre segment is the dominant contributor to revenue and profit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced data centre infrastructure with high power capacity and connectivity, including carrier-neutral and cloud-neutral facilities. It employs state-of-the-art cooling technologies and power provisioning designed to support AI workloads and hyperscale deployments. The MEGA IDC is purpose-built for high-density and AI server deployments, with robust physical and cyber security controls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SUNeVision serves hyperscale cloud providers, telecommunications companies, internet service providers, financial institutions, enterprises, and new economy players. Its customers include international and Chinese cloud service providers, with a growing focus on AI-related deployments and digital infrastructure needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations and assets are primarily located in Hong Kong, with all revenue substantially derived from this region. Key data centres are located in Chai Wan, Sha Tin, Tseung Kwan O, Fanling, and Tsuen Wan within Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: SUNeVision operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the data centre supply chain, providing data centre space, connectivity, and managed IT infrastructure services. It owns and operates data centres and cable landing stations, facilitating interconnection and colocation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding data centre capacity to meet AI inference demand, enhancing connectivity infrastructure, and maintaining premium service quality. It invests in energy-efficient and sustainable technologies, aiming for carbon neutrality and ESG leadership. Agile capital expenditure aligned with customer demand and innovation in cooling and power systems are key R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through leasing data centre space and IT facilities, interconnection services, and managed services. The ELV and IT systems segment contributes through installation and maintenance service fees. The company also earns rental income and interest income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SUNeVision is the largest data centre service provider in Hong Kong and a leading connectivity hub in Asia, with MEGA-i ranked among the top five globally for connectivity. It positions itself as a premium player with superior infrastructure and long-term service stability, differentiating from competitors by ownership of data centres and advanced facilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended June 2025, SUNeVision reported revenue of HK$2.94 billion, a 10% increase year-on-year, and EBITDA of HK$2.13 billion, up 15%. Profit attributable to owners was HK$979 million, up 8%. The company has total assets of HK$24.9 billion and maintains a healthy adjusted gearing ratio of 31% excluding shareholder loans. It has demonstrated consistent growth driven by new data centre capacity and strong operational cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SUNeVision offers premium, carrier-neutral, cloud-neutral data centre services with exceptional connectivity, including extensive subsea cable landing stations. Its facilities are designed for high power density and AI workloads, providing rapid deployment capabilities within 4-6 months. The company emphasizes stringent security, sustainability with top-tier green certifications, and long-term stability through ownership of its data centres, catering to hyperscale and enterprise customers with evolving digital infrastructure needs.
